priorityList: Apply and maintain Virulent Plague using Outbreak.
Cast Army of the Dead when available.
Cast Dark Transformation whenever available, ideally while Army of the Dead is active.
Cast Soul Reaper if the target is below 35% health or during Reaping windows.
Use offensive Trinkets and Racials (like Blood Fury or Berserking) while Dark Transformation is active.
Cast Death Coil if you have a Sudden Doom proc or if you have fewer than 2 Runes available.
Cast Death Coil if you are about to cap Runic Power.
If talented into Festering Scythe, cast Festering Strike to maintain the Festering Scythe buff or debuff.
Cast Festering Strike if you have 0 stacks of the Lesser Ghoul Ready buff.
Cast Scourge Strike if you have 1 or more stacks of the Lesser Ghoul Ready buff to summon a ghoul.
Cast Putrefy if Dark Transformation has more than 12 seconds remaining on cooldown.
Cast Putrefy if you are at maximum charges and Dark Transformation is not immediately available.
Cast Death Coil as your primary filler to spend Runic Power.
